mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% for three months) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 60-day periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% annualized (GDPC1 < 1.0%) signals economic weakness that triggers short-term equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 is below 1.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 500 thousand units (HOUST > 500) during housing market recovery signals strong consumer spending support, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 500 thousand units.
